Content.SourceString: 我想去趟唱片店，要一起来吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm heading over to the Record Shop. Wanna tag along?

Content.SourceString: 好哦，正闲着没事做。
Content.LocalizedString: Sure, I'm free right now.

Content.SourceString: 唱片店？是要去买什么东西吗？
Content.LocalizedString: The Record Shop? Are you looking to buy something?

Content.SourceString: 见面再聊吧，能说得更清楚一些。
Content.LocalizedString: I can explain what's going on a bit more clearly in person. Let's talk once you get here.

Content.SourceString: 总之先来livehouse吧，我在这里等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Just come to the Livehouse first—I'll be waiting here.

Content.SourceString: 总之先来livehouse吧，我在这里等你。
Content.LocalizedString: Just come to the Livehouse first—I'll be waiting here.

Content.SourceString: 我这里遇到点麻烦，需要你帮个忙。
Content.LocalizedString: I've run into a bit of a pickle. Could you help me out?

Content.SourceString: 发生什么了？
Content.LocalizedString: What happened?

Content.SourceString: 你现在在哪里？
Content.LocalizedString: Where are you right now?

Content.SourceString: 情况有点复杂。我现在在克莱门学园，直接来这里找我吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a bit complicated. I'm at Clement Academy, so come on over and find me.

Content.SourceString: 我在学校门口等你。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll wait for you at the school gate.

Content.SourceString: 我在学校门口等你。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll wait for you at the school gate.

Content.SourceString: 在忙吗？没有打扰到你吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you busy? I'm not interrupting you, am I?

Content.SourceString: 不忙不忙，有什么事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not busy. What's up?

Content.SourceString: 正在闲着，谈不上打扰。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm free right now, so you're not bothering me.

Content.SourceString: 那就好。没事的话，今晚一起出来散散步吧？
Content.LocalizedString: That's good to hear. If you're free, want to go for a walk together tonight?

Content.SourceString: 我把地点发给你，到时候直接过来就行。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll send you the location. Feel free to swing by.

Content.SourceString: 那就晚上见啦。
Content.LocalizedString: See you tonight, then!

Content.SourceString: 那就晚上见啦。
Content.LocalizedString: See you tonight, then!

Content.SourceString: 嗨，我是明音。从哈尼娅那里要到了你的手机号
Content.LocalizedString: Hi, this is Akane. I got your phone number from Haniel.

Content.SourceString: 跟着小鸟和小猫一起胡闹，真是辛苦你了
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks for sticking with the birdie and the kitty through all that chaos.

Content.SourceString: 你也辛苦了。也麻烦你陪着一起参加演出了。
Content.LocalizedString: You worked hard, too. And thanks for joining us for the performance.

Content.SourceString: 不辛苦，感觉还是挺有意思的。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry about it. I had a lot of fun.
Mhm…

Content.SourceString: 其实……我也很久没有在观众面前表演了。久违的感觉……还挺叫人怀念的
Content.LocalizedString: Honestly… It's been a long time since I performed in front of an audience, too. That feeling of being back onstage… I really missed it.

Content.SourceString: 欸……本来一开始觉得完全是在胡闹，没想到真的举办了live，还有这么多观众
Content.LocalizedString: Frankly… At first I thought the whole thing was us just messing around. I never expected us to actually put on a live show—and in front of this many people.

Content.SourceString: 我看明音你也很享受站在舞台上的感觉，不是吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Akane, you really enjoy being onstage, don't you?

Content.SourceString: 的确有在享受表演就是了
Content.LocalizedString: I do.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟……自从乐队解散之后我就知道，站在舞台上表演的机会只会越来越少。要抓住每一次能够演出的机会才行
Content.LocalizedString: After all… ever since the band broke up, I've known that opportunities to perform onstage would only grow fewer and farther between. I have to seize every chance I get to take the stage!

Content.SourceString: 我知道，所谓的「不留遗憾」是不可能做到的。所以我们也就只能一边说着「不留遗憾」，一边带着遗憾继续前进吧
Content.LocalizedString: I know it's impossible to live with "no regrets." So I guess all we can do is keep telling ourselves that we must carry our regrets with us and move forward anyway.

Content.SourceString: 啊，这样看来，我岂不是算是「猫头音！！！！」正式的一员了吗
Content.LocalizedString: So this must mean I'm officially a member of "THE WHOOTS!!!!" now, huh?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Actually, you've been one for a while.

Content.SourceString: 我觉得其实你在livehouse选择帮助我们的那一刻，就已经算是「猫头音！！！！」的一员了。
Content.LocalizedString: Honestly, I think you've been a member of "THE WHOOTS!!!!" ever since you chose to help us at the Livehouse.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，乐队成员啊……真是个熟悉又陌生的词
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, a member of a band… A familiar yet unfamiliar term.

Content.SourceString: 这样的话，为了乐队的未来，就请一起努力吧
Content.LocalizedString: Then let's work hard together for the sake of the band's future.

Content.SourceString: 怎么样，校庆上还玩得开心吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So, did you have fun at the school festival?

Content.SourceString: 嗯，今天真是来了不少人，很开心。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah, quite a few people showed up today. It was a lot of fun.

Content.SourceString: 还好。就是感觉有点累了。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm okay. Just feeling a little tired.

Content.SourceString: 辛苦了，好好休息一下
Content.LocalizedString: Good work. Get some rest.

Content.SourceString: 你觉得怎么样？很久没有回学校，给你的感觉很不一样吧？
Content.LocalizedString: What about you? Coming back to school after so long must feel pretty different, huh?

Content.SourceString: 是啊。故地重游，还见到了许多旧人
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah. Coming back here and seeing so many familiar faces…

Content.SourceString: 最主要的是……心里放下了一件很沉重的事情，感觉变得一身轻松了
Content.LocalizedString: Most importantly… I finally let go of something that had been weighing heavily on me. I feel a lot lighter now.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，其实我觉得你早就该主动开口了。
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, honestly, I think you should've spoken up sooner.

Content.SourceString: 嗯……所谓「万事开头难」吧。最难的，就是开口说出那第一句话
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… It's like they say, "The first step is the hardest." For me, the hardest part was getting those first words out.

Content.SourceString: 「平行线」解散后，我们之间的联系就少很多了。或多或少的，大家都在主动避免谈起那天的事情
Content.LocalizedString: After "LINES" disbanded, we gradually lost touch with one another. To some extent, we were all deliberately avoiding talking about what happened that day.

Content.SourceString: 多亏有你，我才能抓住这次机会，没让它因我的胆小和犹豫溜走……
Content.LocalizedString: Thanks to you, I was able to seize this opportunity instead of letting it slip through my fingers because of my fear and hesitation…

Content.SourceString: 真的很感谢你，鉴定师
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you so much, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 我真的你为感到高兴，明音。而且，我想哈尼娅和娜娜莉也是如此。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really happy for you, Akane. And I think Haniel and Nanally feel the same way.

Content.SourceString: 哈，谢谢你们
Content.LocalizedString: Aw, thanks, everyone.

Content.SourceString: 不论是「平行线」还是「猫头音！！！！」的大家……果然你们才是我玩乐队的动力和意义
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone in "LINES" and "THE WHOOTS!!!!"… You all are the reason I play in a band—and what makes it meaningful to me.

Content.SourceString: 我在想下一次开live的地点，你有什么想法吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm trying to figure out where to hold our next live show. Got any ideas?

OptionText.LocalizedString: How about outside in the streets of Hethereau?

Content.SourceString: 还是在star sign里？
Content.LocalizedString: At StarSign again?

Content.SourceString: 在海特洛的街头怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: What do you think about performing in the streets of Hethereau?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……不是不可以。但空间有点小，不知道能不能容纳下全部观众
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… It's not impossible, but the space is a little tight. I'm not sure it'll fit everyone in the audience.

Content.SourceString: 很有摇滚的味道，不过没有提前报备，我们不会被治安官们抓起来吗
Content.LocalizedString: It's got a real rock vibe, but if we don't report it in advance, won't the security officers arrest us?

Content.SourceString: 那明音你有什么想法吗？
Content.LocalizedString: What are your thoughts, Akane?

Content.SourceString: 租个足够大的场馆，能装上千人的那种
Content.LocalizedString: Let's rent a venue big enough to hold over a thousand people.

Content.SourceString: 等一下，上千人？我们真的有那么多粉丝会来看吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, over a thousand people? Would that many people really come to see us?

Content.SourceString: 到时候场馆的座位要是空一大半可就尴尬了……
Content.LocalizedString: It'd be pretty awkward if more than half the seats were empty…

Content.SourceString: 就算是也不至于尴尬吧？为观众带来舒适的视听享受才是最重要的
Content.LocalizedString: Even if they were, it wouldn't be that big of a deal, would it? What matters most is giving the people who do come an unforgettable experience.

Content.SourceString: 顺便一说，我们的热度比你想象的要高得多。虽说还不到爆火的程度，但已经在海特洛新晋乐队榜上名列前茅了
Content.LocalizedString: By the way, we're a lot more popular than you might think! We're not exactly going viral, but we're already near the top of Hethereau's New Band Chart.

Content.SourceString: 还有，我们的呗果账号「黄昏起飞的猫头音！！！！」也有一万多关注
Content.LocalizedString: Not to mention, our Bagel account "Dusk-Flying THE WHOOTS!!!!" has over ten thousand followers.

Content.SourceString: 「黄昏起飞的猫头音！！！！」？我们还有官方呗果账号吗？我怎么不知道？
Content.LocalizedString: "Dusk-Flying THE WHOOTS!!!!"? We have an official Bagel account? Who was going to tell me?

Content.SourceString: 哈尼娅的主意。本来是她的小号之一，后来改成我们乐队的官方账号了
Content.LocalizedString: It was Haniel's idea, originally. It started as one of her alt accounts, but she eventually turned it into our band's official account.

Content.SourceString: 所以官方账号上面大部分都是她自己的私货
Content.LocalizedString: So the official account is mostly just her personal stuff…

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，可以想象。
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, I can imagine.

Content.SourceString: 话说鉴定师，你平时玩游戏吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, Appraiser—do you play any video games?

Content.SourceString: 呃……没事的时候会玩一玩。
Content.LocalizedString: Uh… I sometimes play when I've got nothing going on.

Content.SourceString: 我是游戏领域大神。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm basically a gaming god.

Content.SourceString: 嗯……那你知不知道一款叫做《愤怒的猫头鹰》的游戏？
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… do you know the game "Angry Owl"?

Content.SourceString: 前几天哈尼娅分享给我的。说是她在刷呗果时弹出的广告里下载的
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel shared it with me a few days ago. She said she downloaded it from an ad that popped up while she was browsing Bagel.

OptionText.LocalizedString: …That totally doesn't sound like a scam.

Content.SourceString: 就只是单纯用来骗钱的广告吧？感觉不是很靠谱的样子啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Probably just a straight-up cash grab, right? It doesn't sound all that legit…

Content.SourceString: 如今看来，确实……
Content.LocalizedString: Now that you've got me thinking about it, yeah…

Content.SourceString: 我也稍微……玩了一会。初始给你三颗心，全部用完后就显示充钱，或者分享给好友获得额外游玩次数
Content.LocalizedString: I played it for a little while too, you know… You start with three hearts, and once you use them all up, it tells you to pay or share with friends to get extra chances to play.

Content.SourceString: 这绝对是那种用来骗钱的垃圾小游戏……
Content.LocalizedString: That's a textbook trashy mobile game designed to scam you out of your money…

Content.SourceString: 她发誓要集齐全部款式的猫头鹰，果然看到盲盒就走不动道
Content.LocalizedString: Haniel swore she'd collect every owl variant in the game, so now she won't walk past a mystery box without stopping!

Content.SourceString: 从她沉迷扭蛋的情况来看，下个月的零花钱估计又没了
Content.LocalizedString: Judging by how hooked she is on gacha games, her allowance next month is probably already spoken for.

Content.SourceString: 不过里面的小猫头鹰的确很可爱，我也充了点钱进去……
Content.LocalizedString: But the little owl in the game really is cute. I even spent a little money on it myself…

Content.SourceString: 怎么连你也……请下载海特洛反诈APP（帮哈尼娅也下一个）。
Content.LocalizedString: Not you, too… Please download the Hethereau anti-scam app (and download it for Haniel, too).

Content.SourceString: 有空来Livehouse试试我最新的独家特调
Content.LocalizedString: When you have time, swing by the Livehouse and try my latest House Special.

OptionText.LocalizedString: You know how to mix drinks, too?

Content.SourceString: 我不知道你还会调酒的。
Content.LocalizedString: I didn't know you could mix drinks.

Content.SourceString: 被清泽撺掇的。说什么有客人觉得喝了我亲手调出来的饮料，上台演出就能更顺利
Content.LocalizedString: Kiyosawa talked me into it. Said some customers felt that drinking stuff I'd mixed myself helped their performances go more smoothly.

Content.SourceString: 为了耳朵能享受到更好的演出，我姑且也出一份力吧
Content.LocalizedString: If it means I get to hear better performances, I might as well do my part.

Content.SourceString: 你要来的话，就为你特调一杯无酒精的
Content.LocalizedString: If you're coming, I'll make you a special mocktail.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Is that a part of your job now, too?

Content.SourceString: 这也算在你的工作内容里吗？明音真是什么都会啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Is that part of your job, too? Is there anything you can't do, Akane?

Content.SourceString: 最近还被其他乐队拉去救火，帮忙弹上好几首
Content.LocalizedString: Lately, other bands have even been calling me in to fill in for them, so I've also ended up playing several songs for them…

Content.SourceString: 更不用说帮人调音换弦什么的了……怎么说都不在我的工作职责范围内吧！怎么清泽一说我就去干了……
Content.LocalizedString: Not to mention tuning instruments and changing strings for people as well… That's not even part of my job! So why did I go and do it just because Kiyosawa asked…?

OptionText.LocalizedString: You're way too easy to talk into doing things.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈，你的耳根子太软了。
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, you're just way too easy to convince.

Content.SourceString: 再这样的话，我就该找她谈谈涨工资的事了
Content.LocalizedString: At this rate, I might have to talk to her about getting a raise.

OptionText.SourceString: 为什么要在这里打工呢？

Content.SourceString: 话说……明音为什么要选择在Livehouse里打工呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So… what made you choose to work at the Livehouse?

Content.SourceString: 相对其他工作来说比较清闲，最主要的……可能还是我喜欢这里的氛围吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Compared to my other jobs, it's actually pretty laid-back. More than anything… I suppose I just like the atmosphere there?

Content.SourceString: 以观众视角看乐队们的表演，能总结出很多改进舞台演出的点子
Content.LocalizedString: Watching other bands perform from the audience's perspective gives me plenty of ideas for improving our own shows.

Content.SourceString: 当然……一开始根本没想这些
Content.LocalizedString: Though… That wasn't why I initially started doing it.

Content.SourceString: 音乐……是我无法割舍的东西啊
Content.LocalizedString: Music… is just something I can't let go of.

OptionText.LocalizedString: You can't give up on being in a band, can you?

Content.SourceString: 所以……其实你潜意识里还是不愿意放弃玩乐队吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Deep down, you really don't want to let go of your dream of being in a band, right?

Content.SourceString: 不过好在，现在得偿所愿了。
Content.LocalizedString: But at least you've got what you wanted now.

Content.SourceString: 是啊，或者说……一开始就从未离开过
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah… or rather, I never really let go in the first place.

Content.SourceString: 突发奇想，又想试试架子鼓了
Content.LocalizedString: I suddenly wanna try playing the drums again.

Content.SourceString: 你不爱你的吉他了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Not feeling your guitar anymore?

Content.SourceString: 不会是要替换掉我了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: You're not replacing me, are you?

Content.SourceString: 别乱想
Content.LocalizedString: Haha, don't overthink it.

Content.SourceString: 只是换换口味，海月说可以锻炼手臂肌肉，强身健体
Content.LocalizedString: I just want to branch out. Aurelia said it would work out my arms and help keep me fit.

OptionText.LocalizedString: That's a bit of an exaggeration, isn't it?

Content.SourceString: 的确会用到小臂，但……应该没有到能够锻炼的程度吧？
Content.LocalizedString: It does work your forearms, sure, but… probably not enough to count as an actual workout, right?

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，看来是缺少负重训练的强度
Content.LocalizedString: Well… I suppose drumming isn't intense enough to count as weight training.

Content.SourceString: 这样的话，只要把鼓槌里灌满铅就能达到锻炼的效果了吧
Content.LocalizedString: Or, I could fill the drumsticks with lead, which would mimic weight training, right?

OptionText.LocalizedString: That's a bit terrifying to think about.

Content.SourceString: 听上去像是什么凶器之类的东西啊。要锻炼的话就老老实实地去举铁啊……
Content.LocalizedString: Lead-filled drumsticks sound like some sort of weapon. If you want to work out, just hit the gym…

Content.SourceString: 这不练习乐器和锻炼身体两不误嘛
Content.LocalizedString: If I fill them with lead, I can practice playing the drums and work out at the same time.

Content.SourceString: 我之前看一个摇滚乐队的鼓手，他可以左右手各一把吉他，当作鼓槌敲鼓
Content.LocalizedString: I once even saw a drummer in a rock band use a guitar in each hand as drumsticks…

Content.SourceString: 稍微想象了一下那个画面……嗯，果然我对摇滚的理解还是太浅薄了。
Content.LocalizedString: Just imagining that… Hmm. Turns out my understanding of rock music is merely the tip of the iceberg.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你会骑摩托吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, can you ride a motorcycle?

Content.SourceString: 会骑一点，不过不经常骑。
Content.LocalizedString: I can, but I don't ride them that often.

Content.SourceString: 我经常骑摩托在海特洛飙车的。
Content.LocalizedString: I often tear through the streets of Hethereau on my motorcycle.

Content.SourceString: 不错，到时候找个时间一起兜风
Content.LocalizedString: Great! We should take a spin together sometime.

Content.SourceString: 你也会骑摩托吗？感觉平时没怎么见过。
Content.LocalizedString: You ride motorcycles too? I don't think I've ever seen you on one.

Content.SourceString: 平时只是上下班的话，根本用不到。所以偶尔会怀念那种感觉
Content.LocalizedString: Not for everyday commuting. Now and then, though, I kinda miss that feeling of riding around…

Content.SourceString: 刚组建乐队那会，我那辆摩托就是我们乐队的御用座驾
Content.LocalizedString: Back when we first formed the band, my motorcycle was our go-to ride.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Did the three of you ride together on one motorcycle?

Content.SourceString: 你们三个人坐一辆摩托吗？不是超载了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Did all three of you ride one motorcycle? Isn't that a bit… much?

Content.SourceString: 看情况而定……如果一般我负责开车，海月坐后面，铃羽就蹲在前面
Content.LocalizedString: Depends… Usually, I drive, Aurelia rides behind me, and Suzuha hops up on the handlebars.

Content.SourceString: 当然，巡哨鼠鼠要是比较活跃的话，那就是我带着海月，然后让铃羽打车或是骑车。能省一点钱算一点嘛
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, though, if Officer Whisker is out and about, I'll only take Aurelia, and Suzuha will tag along on a bike or take a taxi. Might as well save a little money where we can, you know.

OptionText.LocalizedString: You guys were really roughing it.

Content.SourceString: 听上去像是什么创业初期的团队过苦日子的情节。
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds like something out of a startup team's scrappy early days.

Content.SourceString: 嗯……感觉对于初创的乐队来说也大差不差吧
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… I guess that's more or less how it goes for any newly formed band.

Content.SourceString: 不过这些都还好，那个时候最让人头疼的是没法卖出去的门票
Content.LocalizedString: But it was manageable! Back then, our biggest headache was getting those tickets sold.

Content.SourceString: 好在依靠我们乐队的实力，和我一点点前辈的威严，成功地把票卖给了学校里的后辈们
Content.LocalizedString: Luckily, thanks to our band's talent—and my own, er, "upperclassman clout"—we managed to sell the tickets to our underclassmen at school.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Isn't that basically strong-arming people into buying tickets?

Content.SourceString: 前辈的威严……这真的不是强买强卖么？
Content.LocalizedString: Your upperclassman clout… Isn't that basically just strong-arming people into buying tickets?

Content.SourceString: 喂喂，以我在学校里的知名度，卖几张票不是分分钟的事情
Content.LocalizedString: Come on, with my reputation, selling a few tickets was a piece of cake.

Content.SourceString: 虽然一开始卖票的时候是很难卖出去啦，偶尔自己掏腰包也算是可以接受吧……
Content.LocalizedString: Well, selling tickets was pretty tough at first, but I guess buying a few myself now and then wasn't so bad…
